newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Industrial Building a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Industrial Building a buy.

text.p: The asset value of Israel's Industrial Buildings Ltd, a property development and management company, is worth about 3.5 times its share price, UBS Ltd said in a report released on Sunday.

Analyst Daniel Carasso said Industrial Buildings' "market updated book value," which he defined as the replacement value of the company's real estate assets, was 10.7 shekels per share. That compared with a share price of 3.1 shekels at the time the report was completed.
"We continue to rate the stock a buy," he said.
In trading on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange today, the share rose 10 percent to 5.12 shekels, which analysts said was in response to the report.
Carasso said Industrial Building's business remains strong, with space under managment up 16 percent in the first nine months of 1996 and an 89-90 percent occupancy rate.

He said that due to strong third-quarter results, he was upgrading 1996-98 revenue and profit forecasts. Operating income he estimated would reach 100 million shekels in 1996, 108.3 million in 1997 and 119.3 million in 1998.

"The dividend yield should rise from approximately five percent now to 13-14 percent in 1999-2001 due to high anticipated profits in those years from a large Tel Aviv project," Carasso said. "Before this and as expansion unfolds, we anticipate significant share price appreciation."
